subject: MAP draft + new timeline proposal — CloudRiver discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@cloudriver.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps from today's call

Jordan — great call today, thanks for the time. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) for CloudRiver. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm ownership for the items in column C (Customer owner) and indicate any internal dependencies you expect (security, legal, procurement).
- What target close date do you want reflected in the MAP? You mentioned end of Q3 as aspirational but that may be tight given procurement windows.
- Would you like us to draft a reduced-scope pilot that surfaces production metrics earlier? Marcus can scope if you want.

Attached: CloudRiver_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx, call-recording-20270816.mp3.

Suggested Redwood owners listed in the file; proposed next checkpoint: 1 week (Mon 8/23) to confirm owners and finalize milestones.

Thanks — I captured the main dependencies in the sheet (security review, procurement PO, integration sandbox access).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@cloudriver.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chong <alex.chong@cloudriver.com>, Procurement Team <procure@cloudriver.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 19:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps from today's call

Tessa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. A couple of things from our side after we debriefed with finance and legal:

- Procurement has a scheduled vendor review the week of 8/30; that means the earliest purchase order (if approved) would be mid-September. Would be safer to set target close to 2027-09-20 rather than end of August.
- Security wants a light-weight data flow diagram and our security team lead (Alex) will need to see SOC2 evidence and sample audit logs.
- We are very interested in a reduced-scope pilot to prove inference latency and cost per 10k calls — if you can provide a one-month pilot plan we can prioritize it in the vendor review.

I'll ask Procurement to share their RFP checklist; cc'ing them now.

Jordan
VP Product | CloudRiver
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@cloudriver.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps from today's call

Adding a couple of notes from the engineering side so they're on the thread:

- We can put together a 4-week pilot (reduced scope) that focuses on a 2-route production proxy: 1) low-latency customer-facing completions, 2) batch embedding pipeline. Pilot artifacts: baseline perf report, cost-per-token estimate, and a 2-week regression test harness.
- For the security ask: attaching an internal checklist we use for SOC2 evidence (I will follow up with a redacted sample audit log).

If Procurement pushes the vendor review to mid-September, proposing these dates:
- Pilot kickoff: 2027-09-06
- Pilot end / metrics review: 2027-10-04
- Target contract signature (if pilot successful): 2027-10-18

Happy to jump on a 20-min call with Alex next week to walk the security items.

— Marcus
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@cloudriver.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps from today's call

Jordan — thanks for the transparency on procurement timing. I updated the MAP draft inline (see attached SOW-outline.pdf for a simplified pilot scope) and reprioritized milestones to reflect the procurement date you signaled:

- Milestone 1 (Priority A): Pilot kickoff (Redwood config + CloudRiver sandbox access) — owner: CloudRiver / Redwood (mutual) — target: 2027-09-06
- Milestone 2 (Priority A): Security review completion (deliverables: data flow diagram, SOC2 evidence, sample logs) — owner: CloudRiver (Alex) / Redwood (Marcus) — target: 2027-09-20
- Milestone 3 (Priority B): Pilot metrics review and decision point — owner: CloudRiver (Jordan) / Redwood (Tessa) — target: 2027-10-04
- Milestone 4 (Priority C): Contract execution — owner: Procurement / Redwood Sales — target: 2027-10-18

Next steps I asked for you to confirm: owners in column C, and whether Procurement can provide the vendor checklist this week (Alex cc'd). If Procurement prefers an earlier internal review, we can compress timelines but would ask for a 2-week fast-track for security artifacts.

Attached: SOW-outline.pdf (pilot scope). I also left a short comment in the MAP draft for the proposed reduced-scope pilot. Proposed checkpoint: Thursday 8/19 at 10am PT — 20 minutes to align owners and confirm procurement timeline. Does that work for you?

Thanks,
Tessa
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@cloudriver.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps from today's call

Quick note from GTM: our allocation for a Q3 onboarding is light given two other pilots in September. If CloudRiver needs faster signal we recommend starting the reduced-scope pilot with a single route (completions) and deferring embeddings to Phase 2 — that reduces initial delivery work by ~30% and gives results for your vendor review.

Happy to coordinate a compressed playbook and owner list if Jordan confirms.

Jordan — if that sounds ok, I'll update the MAP to reflect Phase 1 = completions-only pilot.

— Naomi
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
